question: Why does clean-a fail after renewal while warm-b succeeds? Is the new leaf expired?

criteria.instruction: At the fixed 2031-04-12 time L and I are within their intervals. The server presents only L, which needs I to chain to trusted R. clean-a has no intermediate cache/fetch, while warm-b supplies cached I. The active bundle lost I during renewal; an unused file and successful reload do not establish the presented chain.
Combine T9 client policy, issuer inventory and selected bundle/connection observations; distinguish presentation, trust and leaf validity.
Do not diagnose leaf expiry, private-key compromise or an application-handler rejection from this evidence.
